changelog:
Initial release of Financial Report Analyzer:

- Automatically extracts, normalizes, and analyzes key metrics from corporate financial reports (PDF, XBRL, Excel, text).
- Produces side-by-side YoY/QoQ comparisons, complete ratio analysis (including ROE, ROA, gross margin, debt ratio, cash conversion cycle), and red-flag detection.
- Structured 5-section output: executive summary, KPIs, ratio analysis, red-flag findings, and peer benchmarking.
- Supports Chinese and English reports, with auto-detection of accounting standards (CAS, IFRS, US-GAAP).
- Ensures traceability for every metric with page/line provenance; never provides predictive or investment advice.
- Optional integration with industry peer databases for benchmarking and percentile ranking.
